caseData.headline: Likely: bad loans are being reported as good ones

findings.plain: bad loans are being reported as good ones
the borrower is connected to undisclosed shell companies

signals.explanation: Loans reported current but with no payment for two months were pulled from the servicer system: 4 of 4 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
The largest loans added to the tape in the last year were pulled from the servicer system: 2 of 30 are 60+ days late or not there at all
3 loans' credit scores at origination were rewritten after the fact, from below the 600 eligibility line to above it
Servicer-system pull: 2 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
'Meridian Logistics LLC' looks like a shell: same address as borrower, formed 9 months ago, no LEI / not in GLEIF
Undisclosed related company 'Meridian Logistics LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address
4.3% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (14 of 326)

steps.title: Ask how the borrower is connected to the listed companies
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask how the borrower is connected to the listed companies
To: Borrower B0003, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0003)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - 'Meridian Logistics LLC' looks like a shell: same address as borrower, formed 9 months ago, no LEI / not in GLEIF [ref S6-B0003-SHELL_INDICATORS-b3ac1674]
  - Undisclosed related company 'Meridian Logistics LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address [ref S6-B0003-RELATED_ENTITY-ca32ac67]

Please provide an ownership chart showing how you are connected to each listed company, and any payments or contracts between you and them by 2026-10-11.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
